notes: First public version of the web app and the Android app (APK, not on Google Play). Vexunori is free to use but not open source.
The Android app is build-verified only: it has not yet been installed or run on a phone or emulator.
End-to-end encrypted 1:1 and group messages (NIP-17: NIP-44 v2 + gift wraps) over Nostr relays, with honest queued / sent-to-relays / delivered / read statuses.
Replies, reactions, edits, delete for everyone, disappearing messages, pins, bookmarks, drafts and local search.
Attachments up to 3 files of 1.5 MB each, verified by SHA-256 on arrival.
Identity on your device with passphrase or Android Keystore protection; encrypted backups, device linking and a recovery kit.
Contact verification with safety numbers; message requests and blocking.
Encrypted Vault, Spaces (protected Spaces with their own passphrase), Privacy Bridge and Passports.
Shared group workspaces: tasks, to-dos, polls, notes, events, links, files and bookmarks; personal reminders on your device.
Privacy Center: health check, local privacy receipts, SendGuard file and link review, Emergency Freeze.
Morse translator, keyer, audio/light/vibration playback; experimental microphone decoding.
Offline hand-over with QR parcels and parcel files; experimental LAN relay support.
Experimental: Tor via Orbot on Android; 1:1 WebRTC calls (off by default, reveal your IP address, no TURN relay, disabled in strict Tor mode).

Known limitations: no forward secrecy; relays see metadata; contacts added by npub only may not receive messages (no NIP-17 inbox-relay lookup); no typing indicators; no Bluetooth or Wi-Fi Direct mesh; notifications only while the app runs; no external audit.
